## Apple to Revise App Tracking Rules Following German Antitrust Ruling

Forced revisions to Apple's app tracking rules by a major jurisdiction risk setting a precedent for broader privacy and ad-tech policy changes across the EU and beyond, with downstream implications for AAPL's App Store monetization surface and the ad-tech ecosystem broadly.

- Apple will revise its app tracking rules following a decision by German antitrust authorities, per GuruFocus and Simply Wall St.
- Both outlets carried consistent framing with no conflicting detail on the nature or scope of the required changes.
- The story is classified high confidence on antitrust action and platform take-rate themes.
- No specific timeline, scope of revisions, or financial impact is quantified in the headlines.
